text: Chedrick Greene Appointed to Four Michigan Senate Committees

GET INVOLVEDTeam Greene is looking for volunteers to join our coalition to elect Chedrick Greene as our next State Senator here in Michigan’s 35th District. We need your help talking to family, friends, and neighbors across the district to earn their support and mobilize them to turn out for this unique special election.
